title: acer laurinum
intro: Acer laurinum, commonly known as laurel maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Acer laurinum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve circulation, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Acer laurinum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-anaphylactic, and anti-ulcerogenic effects.
